findings.title: Formal Railway reviewer identity is not bound to the required reviewer role
findings.exact_failure: Changing only the typed Railway review reviewer from railway-domain-reviewer to fixture-implementer, while preserving the required railway-domain-reviewer role and distinct run/session identifiers, was accepted by the complete production suite: exit 0, 34 passed, 0 failed.
findings.reproducible_read_only_check: In an isolated temp copy, replace only the formal Railway review reviewer value in run-bootstrap-production-integration.mjs with fixture-implementer and run the production integration suite.
findings.impact: Any non-empty reviewer label can claim the formal railway-domain slot. The mechanism does not fail closed on reviewer-role substitution and does not complete formal reviewer identity validation.
minimum_remediation: Require review.reviewer to equal railway-domain-reviewer for type railway-domain.
Validate did_not_participate_in_implementation=true or derive it from validated reviewer-assignment and handoff identities.
Add a production negative case and mutation for reviewer substitution.

findings.title: The 68-fixture Domain path bypasses the official Railway schema loader
findings.exact_failure: Replacing the official Railway schema with malformed JSON in an isolated temp copy still produced fixture exit 0 with 68 passed and 0 failed.
findings.reproducible_read_only_check: In an isolated temp copy, replace railway-domain-review.schema.json with malformed JSON and run node .codex/tests/run-governance-fixtures.mjs.
findings.impact: The fixture and production paths do not use the same official schema loader. Fixtures can report complete success while the official typed Railway contract is malformed or unavailable.
minimum_remediation: Invoke loadAndCompileGovernanceSchemas from the fixture path or route typed fixture validation through validateTask.
Validate the typed Railway fixture with the official schema.
Add fixture and mutation cases proving malformed, missing and bypassed Railway schemas fail closed.
